newsitem.title: USA: Petroleum Heat FY96 heating oil volume.
newsitem.headline: Petroleum Heat FY96 heating oil volume.

text.p: Petroleum Heat and Power Co said on Wednesday 1996 retail heating oil volume was expected to be about 455 million to 457 million gallons.

Earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), excluding charges related to the company's operational restructuring program and accounting for the company's investment in Star Gas Partners SBI, was forecast to be $46 million to $49 million in 1996, it said.

Chairman Irik Sevin said: "In the fourth quarter of 1996, the first winter quarter following implementation of the regionalization program in Long Island, that region's oil delivery, repair and maintenance and customer attrition statistics all improved 5 percent to 15 percent, as compared with the same period in 1995.

He said he was disappointed with the effect of December's extremely warm Northeast weather on 1996 results, but fourth quarter operating results on Long Island suggested the Company's fundamental operating strategy was sound.
